spec: primary: top-3, beat all but 1 of 69 films, band 2-16, hub on, time rule on, best source; p exact unless noted

definitions.mean_of_sources: average over the documented sources of the share of comparison comics beating that source
definitions.first_listed: first-listed source only; the other documented source stays out of the comparison set
definitions.first_listed_only: first-listed source only; the other documented source becomes an ordinary comparison comic
definitions.against_mean_source_z: share of comparison comics beating the mean z of the sources

rate_variants.note: the expectation-corrected rate is a positive affine transform of the raw rate within each comic, so with the hub adjustment it gives exactly the primary result; it is reported without the hub
